title: Precision--Recall Trade-off on the Inference Level for LLMs in Grammatical Error Correction
abstract: arXiv:2610.41698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been adopted for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC), achieving strong performance via both full fine-tuning and prompt-based approaches. As probabilistic sequence models, LLMs expose inference-time parameters that directly modify token generation behavior; however, their potential for controlling GEC-specific trade-offs has not been systematically studied. In this work, we investigate decoding strategies for grammatical error correction. We show that the repetition penalty parameter enables controllable adjustment of the precision--recall trade-off at inference time, without modifying the model architecture, training procedure, or prompt. Through experiments on standard GEC benchmarks, we demonstrate that repetition-penalty-based decoding enables inference-time control of the precision--recall balance, conceptually related to methods previously proposed for sequence-to-sequence GEC models, such

translated_title: 大语言模型在语法纠错任务中推理层面的精确率—召回率权衡
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）近期被应用于语法错误纠正（GEC）任务，通过全量微调和基于提示的方法均取得了出色的性能。作为概率序列模型，大语言模型提供了可直接修改token生成行为的推理时参数；然而，这些参数在控制语法纠错特定权衡方面的潜力尚未得到系统性研究。在本工作中，我们研究了语法错误纠正的解码策略。我们发现，重复惩罚参数能够在推理时实现对精确率—召回率权衡的可控调整，而无需修改模型架构、训练过程或提示。通过在标准语法纠错基准上的实验，我们证明了基于重复惩罚的解码可以实现对精确率—召回率平衡的推理时控制，在概念上与先前针对序列到序列语法纠错模型提出的方法相关……
tldr: 本研究发现，仅通过调整大语言模型推理时的重复惩罚参数，即可在不修改模型架构、训练过程或提示的情况下，灵活控制语法纠错任务中精确率与召回率的权衡。
en_tdlr: This study shows that the repetition penalty parameter enables inference-time, controllable adjustment of the precision–recall trade-off for LLM-based grammatical error correction, without modifying the model architecture, training procedure, or prompt.
